title: New Leadership for Austin Housing Deals
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) approved new board members for 23 nonprofit corporations.
*   These nonprofits are crucial partners in managing and owning affordable housing developments across Austin, including projects like Aldridge 51 and Seabrook Square.
*   This decision supports the ongoing operation and future of various housing projects in the city.
